_about: Generated by admin/lexicon/image-licence-debt.mjs from committed files; do not edit by hand. A work list, not a verdict: 'recorded' means the sidecar names a recognisable licence, not that its source page was checked. Each port lists only its images in debt, by state: missing (no sidecar), unreadable (sidecar not JSON), unverified (Flickr, licence never read), incomplete (no version, a site name, or not recognised), restricted (permission or all rights reserved by others, no record).
